title: Sliders, Drags & Text Input
summary: SliderFloat, DragFloat3, InputFloat/Int and InputText, format strings, clamp and logarithmic flags, and the IsItemActivated / IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit pattern behind undo systems.

quiz.q: You Ctrl+Click a scale slider (range 0.01..100) and type 0. How do you prevent that?
quiz.explain: By default typed values may go out of range. AlwaysClamp clamps typed input too.

quiz.q: What is the correct third argument for InputText("Name", e->name, ???) where name is char[32]?
quiz.explain: Pass the full buffer capacity (32). ImGui leaves room for the terminating zero itself.

quiz.q: Where should an editor push ONE undo entry for a slider drag?
quiz.explain: The return value is true on every frame of a drag. IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit fires once, on release, and only if something changed.

options: Value change per pixel of mouse movement
quiz.explain: v_speed is units per pixel dragged. With min == max == 0 the drag has no limits.
